name: Star vs. the Forces of Evil
description: Intergalactic warrior Star Butterfly arrives on Earth to live with the Diaz family. She continues to battle villains throughout the universe and high school, mainly to protect her extremely powerful wand, an object that still confuses her.

videos.title: Star Comes to Earth
videos.overview: As tradition dictates, Star receives the royal magic wand for her 14th birthday, but her parents worry that she is not ready for the responsibility and send her to a place they deem safe - Earth.

videos.title: Party With a Pony
videos.overview: Star's best friend from her home dimension pays a visit and feels threatened by Star's new friendship with Marco.

videos.title: Match Maker
videos.overview: Star fails her first test, so she tries to play match maker for their classroom teacher to get a better grade. However, she winds up turning her into a troll.

videos.title: School Spirit
videos.overview: While Marco is distracted by protecting his friend, the new school mascot, from being kidnapped by their football rivals, a confused Star believes this to be an upcoming battlefield and starts making plans of her own.

videos.title: Monster Arm
videos.overview: Marco breaks his arm before a Karate tournament. Star uses her wand to fix it, but accidentally gives him an evil sentient tentacle arm.

videos.title: The Other Exchange Student
videos.overview: Star vies for attention with a foreign exchange student who is visiting the Diaz family.

videos.title: Cheer Up Star
videos.overview: Star is feeling down when her crush Oskar has no calls from her, so Marco tries to cheer her up only that he accidentally summons Ludo and his army of monsters.

videos.title: Quest Buy
videos.overview: Star and Marco must go to "Quest Buy", a maze-like store to find a charger for Star's wand.

videos.title: Diaz Family Vacation
videos.overview: Star takes the Diaz family out vacation to her home dimension of Mewni.

videos.title: Brittney's Party
videos.overview: Star doesn't get invited to Brittany's birthday party and is desperate to get into it.

videos.title: Mewberty
videos.overview: Star goes through mewberty, which covers her body in purple hearts and sets her off onto all the boys in school.

videos.title: Pixtopia
videos.overview: Marco and his friends work off their debt in the Shard Mines.

videos.title: Lobster Claws
videos.overview: Ludo fires the lobster monster from his group and the creature doesn't know what to do, so Star and Marco try to help him out.

videos.title: Sleep Spells
videos.overview: Star is sleepwalking and casting magic chaotically.

videos.title: Blood Moon Ball
videos.overview: Star accepts her ex-boyfriend Tom's invitation to Demon Prom, but Marco is suspicious of Tom's intentions.

videos.title: Fortune Cookies
videos.overview: Marco convinces Star that fortune cookies contain magical prophecies, which leads her to dangerously believe a fake fortune.

videos.title: Freeze Day
videos.overview: Star accidentally freezes time with her wand and then tries to convince Father Time to set things right.

videos.title: Royal Pain
videos.overview: Star's dad makes an unexpected visit and soon wears out his welcome.

videos.title: St. Olga's Reform School for Wayward Princesses
videos.overview: Star must face her greatest fear and travel to St. Olga's Reform School for Wayward Princesses to bust out Flying Princess Pony Head for her birthday.

videos.title: Mewnipendance Day
videos.overview: Star leads a battle reenactment as part of a Mewni Independence Day celebration with her friends on Earth.

videos.title: The Banagic Incident
videos.overview: Star sees a commercial for a magical Earth product.

videos.title: Interdimensional Field Trip
videos.overview: Star leads a class field trip to a museum in another dimension and puts the entire class in danger.

videos.title: Marco Grows a Beard
videos.overview: When Star flubs the spell used to help Marco grow a beard, the beard grows out of control and engulf the house.

videos.title: Storm the Castle
videos.overview: When Marco is captured by Toffee and held for wand-ransom, Star enters into an unlikely alliance with Ludo and Buff Frog.

videos.title: My New Wand!
videos.overview: Star must learn how to free Marco from a magically locked closet without using her new wand.

videos.title: Ludo in the Wild
videos.overview: When Ludo is thrown into nature, he must overcome the elements and creatures of the wilderness to survive.

videos.title: Mr. Candle Cares
videos.overview: Star rebels after the school guidance counselor, Mr. Candle, insists that her future is set in stone.

videos.title: Red Belt
videos.overview: Marco finally decides to focus on earning his red belt in karate.

videos.title: Star on Wheels
videos.overview: When Marco teaches Star how to ride a bike but forgets to tell her about brakes, he teams up with Oskar and Glossaryck to save her.

videos.title: Fetch
videos.overview: A mysterious stray dog steals Star’s wand and refuses give it back.

videos.title: Star vs. Echo Creek
videos.overview: Star goes on the run after accidentally crushing a police car.

videos.title: Wand to Wand
videos.overview: Star and Ludo struggle to get their new wands under control.

videos.title: Starstruck
videos.overview: When Star's biggest hero Mina Loveberry, a rogue magic-wielder from Mewni, loses her mojo for battle, Star attempts to help her get it back.

videos.title: Camping Trip
videos.overview: King Butterfly pays a surprise visit to Star during the Diaz family camping trip and brings with him his own brand of camping.

videos.title: Starsitting
videos.overview: When Star and Marco are in charge of watching Buff Frog's tadpoles, the duo’s babysitting styles clash.

videos.title: On the Job
videos.overview: While Star and Marco are babysitting his tadpoles, Buff Frog goes on a mission to steal Mewnian corn but keeps thinking about his tadpoles during the job.

videos.title: Goblin Dogs
videos.overview: Star and her friends wait in the longest food truck line ever for the universe’s best hot dog, the Goblin Dog.

videos.title: By the Book
videos.overview: After an argument with Star, Glossaryck goes into hiding in a donut box.

videos.title: Game of Flags
videos.overview: Star competes in the Game of Flags at the Butterfly-Johansen family reunion against her mother’s orders.

videos.title: Girls' Day Out
videos.overview: When Star is nominated as Mayor of Detention, she must help her constituents with their various problems.

videos.title: Sleepover
videos.overview: Marco sets out to impress Jackie at Star’s slumber party, but a magical truth-telling game threatens to reveal too much for Star.

videos.title: Gift of the Card
videos.overview: Marco must use a gift card before it expires with catastrophic results.

videos.title: Friendenemies
videos.overview: When Tom vies for Marco's company instead of Star's, Marco becomes suspicious.

videos.title: Is Mystery
videos.overview: Worried about his tadpoles' futures, Buff Frog investigates the hole in the Mewman force field.

videos.title: Hungry Larry
videos.overview: Star and Marco help Mr. Diaz create the scariest Haunted House on the block.

videos.title: Spider with a Top Hat
videos.overview: Star's most entertaining spell, Spider with a Top Hat, wants to become a fighting spell instead.

videos.title: Into the Wand
videos.overview: Star travels into her wand to try and fix it.

videos.title: Pizza Thing
videos.overview: When Marco and Pony Head pick up a pizza for Star, the simple task becomes a disaster.

videos.title: Page Turner
videos.overview: Star tries to resist the temptation of reading a forbidden chapter in her Book of Spells.

videos.title: Naysaya
videos.overview: Marco grows a second head that blurts out his secrets and insecurities whenever he tries to ask out Jackie.

videos.title: Bon Bon the Birthday Clown
videos.overview: Star has second thoughts about attending a dead clown's séance, when Jackie asks Marco to go to the school dance with her.

videos.title: Raid the Cave
videos.overview: Star tries to rescue Glossaryck and the Book of Spells from Ludo.

videos.title: Trickstar
videos.overview: Star sets out to prove that party magician Preston Change-O is a real magician.

videos.title: Baby
videos.overview: Star must show her fairy godmother, Baby, what she has learned about magic.

videos.title: Running with Scissors
videos.overview: When Marco abuses the Dimensional Scissors, the Scissors Enforcer, Hekapoo gives Marco an ultimatum.

videos.title: Mathmagic
videos.overview: When Star refuses to solve a problem in math class, she learns that avoiding her least favorite subject may have cosmic repercussions.

videos.title: The Bounce Lounge
videos.overview: When Star discovers that the Bounce Lounge is closing, she and Marco enlist their old Bounce Crew to make sure the party continues.

videos.title: Crystal Clear
videos.overview: Rhombulus is convinced that Star is the source of a universe-wide magical glitch and brings them before the Chancellor of the Magical High Commission.

videos.title: The Hard Way
videos.overview: Ludo forces Glossaryck to teach him about the Book of Spells.

videos.title: Heinous
videos.overview: Ms. Heinous shows up at the Diaz house and Marco must make amends for all the terrible things he has done.

videos.title: All Belts Are Off
videos.overview: Dojo-sensei informs his class that they are going to receive a visit from the Grandmaster of their How-To-Karate video series.

videos.title: Collateral Damage
videos.overview: Star and Janna are cleaning up the school grounds when Star mistakenly picks up the school's possum statue.

videos.title: Just Friends
videos.overview: Star surprises Marco with tickets to a Love Sentence concert, but also invites Jackie.

videos.title: Face the Music
videos.overview: The songstrel Ruberiot is tasked to write a song about Star for the Mewnian tradition of Song Day, but Star is reluctant to participate.

videos.title: Starcrushed
videos.overview: Hoping to help her forget about her strained friendship with Marco, Star's friends convince her to ditch the Diaz' end-of-the-school-year party for a more dangerous bash.

videos.title: Battle for Mewni: Return to Mewni
videos.overview: Star returns to her home dimension of Mewni where she discovers that magic is disappearing throughout the kingdom.

videos.title: Battle for Mewni: Moon the Undaunted
videos.overview: Star must dig deep and challenge archnemesis Ludo in an effort to save her family and kingdom.

videos.title: Battle for Mewni: Book Be Gone
videos.overview: Despite dire warnings, Ludo tries to write a new chapter in the Book of Spells.

videos.title: Battle for Mewni: Marco and the King
videos.overview: King River struggles to keep the kingdom running without Queen Moon's help.

videos.title: Battle for Mewni: Puddle Defender
videos.overview: Buffrog helps Star escape from Moon's ever-protective watch.

videos.title: Battle for Mewni: King Ludo
videos.overview: With Ludo in control of the kingdom, Marco must decide his next move.

videos.title: Battle for Mewni: Toffee
videos.overview: King Ludo's reign reaches as a tipping point as Star returns to the castle. Star must summon her strength to save her family and the kingdom.

videos.title: Scent of a Hoodie
videos.overview: Star secretly keeps Marco's hoodie as a reminder of their friendship.

videos.title: Rest in Pudding
videos.overview: Star has recurring visions of Glossaryck and believes he's haunting her.

videos.title: Club Snubbed
videos.overview: Tom snubs Star at the Silver Bell Ball.

videos.title: Stranger Danger
videos.overview: Star meets the ancient Queen Eclipsa.

videos.title: Demoncism
videos.overview: Star and Tom's relationship is put to the test when Tom decides to get rid of his demons.

videos.title: Sophomore Slump
videos.overview: Marco decides to put a full effort into living life in the present on Earth.

videos.title: Lint Catcher
videos.overview: Knight of the wash, Sir Lavabo, gets a familiar squire.

videos.title: Trial by Squire
videos.overview: Star prepares for the Midnight Warrior Blowout Sale at Quest Buy.

videos.title: Princess Turdina
videos.overview: A surprise visitor pressures Marco to reveal Turdina's true identity.

videos.title: Starfari
videos.overview: Star goes out into the field to understand why Mewmans treat Monsters unfairly.

videos.title: Sweet Dreams
videos.overview: Star discovers she travels through multiple dimensions in her dreams.

videos.title: Lava Lake Beach
videos.overview: Kelly breaks up with her boyfriend and Marco questions his friendship with Star Butterfly.

videos.title: Death Peck
videos.overview: Star urges the royal youth of Mewni to sign a petition calling for the equal treatment of monsters.

videos.title: Ponymonium
videos.overview: Star becomes thrilled when Pony Head invites her to dinner with her sisters.

videos.title: Nightlife
videos.overview: Star learns that Marco and Hekapoo have been dealing with rogue interdimensional portals.

videos.title: Deep Dive
videos.overview: Star's sleep-portaling becomes a danger and she decides to put a stop to it.

videos.title: Monster Bash
videos.overview: All the youth of Mewni gather at the ancient Monster Temple to celebrate a new era of monsters and Mewmans living together in peace -- until guests start disappearing.

videos.title: Stump Day
videos.overview: Star, Marco and the rest of Mewni celebrate a special snowy holiday, "Stump Day."

videos.title: Holiday Spellcial
videos.overview: Spider with a Top Hat invites one of Eclipsa’s dark spells to the office holiday party.

videos.title: The Bogbeast of Boggabah
videos.overview: King River interrupts Star's eager investigation into Eclipsa's past and demands her help on a dangerous hunt.

videos.title: Total Eclipsa the Moon
videos.overview: Moon enlists Eclipsa herself to access Mewni's most guarded records.

videos.title: Butterfly Trap
videos.overview: Moon and the Magical High Commission put Eclipsa on trial for her evil past with Star as a key witness.

videos.title: Ludo, Where Art Thou?
videos.overview: Dennis goes on a dangerous journey to find Ludo living in another dimension.

videos.title: Is Another Mystery
videos.overview: Buffrog leaves Mewni in search for a better life, and Star goes to look for him.

videos.title: Marco Jr.
videos.overview: Marco returns to Echo Creek to discover that his mom is pregnant.

videos.title: Skooled!
videos.overview: Ponyhead returns to St. O’s and finds that the curriculum got tougher.

videos.title: Booth Buddies
videos.overview: A magical photo booth at a wedding goes on the fritz and captures Star and Marco inside.

videos.title: Bam Ui Pati!
videos.overview: Ponyhead shuts herself away to watch the finale of her favorite Korean Drama.

videos.title: Tough Love
videos.overview: Eclipsa and Moon bring Princess Meteora home peacefully after the massive destruction she's caused.

videos.title: Divide
videos.overview: Star becomes acting Queen and plans for Marco and his warriors to delay Meteora from reaching Castle Butterfly long enough for Star to find Moon and destroy the monster princess.

videos.title: Conquer
videos.overview: Star must find the courage to face Meteora alone and make a decision that will change the kingdom forever.

videos.title: Butterfly Follies
videos.overview: Star and Marco go in search of Queen Moon.

videos.title: Escape from the Pie Folk
videos.overview: Star's search for her Mom takes her to the home of the Pie Folk, where she must outwit them in order to reunite her family.

videos.title: Moon Remembers
videos.overview: Moon is back, and Star wants to find the perfect time to tell her about Globgor.

videos.title: Swim Suit
videos.overview: Star and Marco plan their beach day, but Eclipsa needs Star's help with an unexpected problem.

videos.title: Ransomgram
videos.overview: Star and Marco journey to the Neverzone to rescue his friend Nachos from mysterious demons.

videos.title: Lake House Fever
videos.overview: When a storm traps Star at Tom's family lake house, she turns it into a fun excursion.

videos.title: Yada Yada Berries
videos.overview: Star and Marco turn into amateur sleuths to find who tried to turn Eclipsa to stone.

videos.title: Down by the River
videos.overview: Moon and River try to adjust to life after giving up their crowns.

videos.title: The Ponyhead Show!
videos.overview: Star enlists Ponyhead to help make Eclipsa more popular.

videos.title: Surviving the Spiderbites
videos.overview: Star tries her best to distract the Spider Bite family when Eclipsa is late for her first royal dinner.

videos.title: Out of Business
videos.overview: Star, Marco and Janna want to take full advantage of Quest Buy's "Going Out of Business Sale."

videos.title: Kelly's World
videos.overview: Marco and Kelly risk life and limb to return a library book before it's overdue.

videos.title: Curse of the Blood Moon
videos.overview: Star and Marco go on a perilous quest to break the curse of the Blood Moon.

videos.title: Princess Quasar Caterpillar and the Magic Bell
videos.overview: Ludo becomes determined to figure out how to not let his past hinder him any longer and continue on with the rest of his life.

videos.title: Ghost of Butterfly Castle
videos.overview: Moon revisits the Butterfly Castle ruins to discover an item she left behind, but she is soon surprised.

videos.title: Cornball!
videos.overview: Star tries to convince Buff Frog to move back to Mewni.

videos.title: Meteora's Lesson
videos.overview: Glossaryck needs Meteora to help him with an errand.

videos.title: The Knight Shift
videos.overview: Star and Marco have to make some decisions about the future.

videos.title: Queen-Napped
videos.overview: Star and Marco have to rescue a kidnapped Eclipsa.

videos.title: Junkin' Janna
videos.overview: Tom learns how to have fun without Star.

videos.title: A Spell with No Name
videos.overview: Star and Eclipsa's spells come face to face, and they must team up to stop a lethal spell gone rogue.

videos.title: A Boy and His DC-700XE
videos.overview: Marco and Tom go on a dragon-cycling adventure.

videos.title: The Monster and the Queen
videos.overview: Eclipsa has a date with Globgor.

videos.title: Cornonation
videos.overview: Star plans a coronation for Eclipsa to become Queen.

videos.title: Doop-Doop
videos.overview: Star attempts to figure out what to do with her life after she is not responsible for Mewni any longer.

videos.title: Britta's Tacos
videos.overview: Marco is determined to consume 50 tacos in order to win a special prize that is being offered at Britta's Tacos restaurant.

videos.title: Beach Day
videos.overview: Star gets ready to actually have the day at the beach with Marco.

videos.title: Gone Baby Gone
videos.overview: Marco misplaces both Mariposa and Meteora somewhere in Hekapoo's dimension.

videos.title: Sad Teen Hotline
videos.overview: Tom breaks up with Star but is not prepared for the consequences.

videos.title: Jannanigans
videos.overview: Star and Marco need Janna's help to return to Mewni.

videos.title: Mama Star
videos.overview: Star, Marco, Janna and Tom lose their memories as they traverse amnesia-inducing waters to get back to Mewni.

videos.title: Ready, Aim, Fire
videos.overview: Star arrives in Mewni as a soldier attacks Monster Castle.

videos.title: The Right Way
videos.overview: Star Butterfly, Pony Head, Seahorse, Kelly, Rich Pigeon, Jorby, Talon and Quirky Guy all arrive to bail out Eclipsa.

videos.title: Here to Help
videos.overview: Moon arrives to save the day.

videos.title: Pizza Party
videos.overview: Moon and Mina agree to disagree.

videos.title: The Tavern at the End of the Multiverse
videos.overview: Star searches for a way to defeat Mina and her Solarian Warriors.

videos.title: Cleaved
videos.overview: Star and Marco face their final conflict.
